title: rpl host tests: rpl_srh + rpl_dao_timing fail to build on main (pre-existing)
description: Found during b7z9.183 regression sweep (stash-verified pre-existing, unrelated to that change). Two standalone host tests fail to build: (1) rpl_srh: rpl_dao_tx_persist.h:72 includes lichen/hal_storage_redundant.h but the test CMakeLists lacks the hal include dir (same class as the rpl_dis/rpl_dio_time/rpl_short_assignment breakage fixed in b7z9.183 — add hal include + likely hash32.c/hal_storage_redundant.c). (2) rpl_dao_timing: main.c:449 'invalid storage class for function test_rng' — a real compile error in the test file (likely a missing closing brace above line 449). Neither is exercised by CI host runs apparently, or they'd be red. rpl_routing is a Zephyr find_package test and not host-buildable (not a defect).
close_reason: Fixed in adbff84930. (1) rpl_srh: added subsys/lichen/hal/include to target_include_directories — rpl_dao_tx_persist.h:72 transitively includes lichen/hal_storage_redundant.h; include dir alone sufficed (no extra sources needed: test passes, no link deps on hal_storage_redundant.c/hash32.c). (2) rpl_dao_timing: test_tx_loop_initial_retry_refresh was missing its closing brace after 'return true;' (old line 445), leaving all subsequent functions nested -> 'invalid storage class' errors; added the brace. Verified: host cmake+ctest green for both; rpl_dao_timing Zephyr native_sim/native/64 build+run green (dual-mode CMake intact). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3 (correctness/security/edge): all PASS, zero findings. Reviewer note: pre-existing duplicate 'Composed orchestrator' comment banner at main.c:448/524 — cosmetic, pre-existing, not introduced by this change, not filed.
